218:t_1:78.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... No matter what happens, we will live through it...」

218:t_1:79.en:
$$アルト$$
「And then we're going back to Earth. There are enemies waiting there that we have to fight.」

218:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Huh? Aren't you sitting in on the talks with Captain $$マックス$$, $$バサラ$$?」

218:t_10:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I left that side to $$レイ#pt231$$ and $$ミレーヌ$$.」

218:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, you certainly do march to your own beat, $$バサラ$$. Nothing fazes you, no matter the situation.」

218:t_10:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Not really. Get to sing with the galaxy as my stage for the first time in ages, and of course I get fired up.」

218:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's true. The fired-up state you were in when you drove the $$バジュラ$$ back left and right produced $$Ｚチップ$$.」

218:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That amount... 100 Z! I'll add these to the unit's stock.」

218:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... No demanding that I hand over singing royalties, now!」

218:t_10:13.en:
$$バサラ$$
「I can't put it well, but those $$バジュラ$$ aren't like the ones we've fought so far...」

218:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even I can see that the color is different, but...」

218:t_10:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「...Whatever. No matter what they are, I'll make their hearts burn with my song!」

218:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll be looking forward to it. And if you could also warm my wallet with $$Ｚチップ$$ while you're at it, I'd have nothing more to ask for.」

218:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I am so glad you made it back safely!」

218:t_10:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Besides, I heard it from everyone. That you used the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to search for us, $$ＡＧ$$.」

218:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚクリスタル$$, being a crystal of $$Ｚチップ$$, reacts to people's feelings and wishes, after all.」

218:t_10:25.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then it picked up on our wish to get back to everyone, didn't it.」

218:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, it also picked up all sorts of other feelings overflowing from the $$ジェニオン$$, let me tell you.」

218:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s private lesson with the stars of the galaxy as the backdrop...」

218:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oops... you're no longer a 'teacher,' are you.」

218:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course I was, loud and clear.」

218:t_10:32.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You... look like you want to die, huh?」

218:t_10:34.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Never mind. Crushing you would be a real hassle afterward.」

218:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't make me angry, $$ＡＧ$$. If you do, you know what happens, don't you?」

218:t_10:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good kid. Keep yourself in check from now on.」

218:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...No... as you were a moment ago, there's no need to call you 'Miss.'」

218:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never thought the plan I had nearly given up on would get a second wind at this point... This is thanks to $n too.)

218:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So I'm going to give it my all too! Even at the center of the galaxy... business, business!」

219:t_001:1.en:
$n
「I don't know...! They seem to be living creatures, though...!」

219:t_002:1.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! Try to make contact with them...!」

219:t_002:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I've been trying every method I can think of for a while now, but it doesn't seem to work!」

219:t_002:3.en:
$n
(What do I do...? Should I fall back as far as possible...?)

219:t_002:5.en:
$n
(It's dangerous to turn our backs here... Then the only choice is to fight...)

219:t_004:0.en:
$$レド$$
「Get away from there, $n! Those are $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$!」

219:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So those are the creatures fighting the $$人類銀河同盟$$...」

219:t_005:1.en:
$$レド$$
「This whole area seems to be their habitat. Now that we've stepped into it, we have no choice but to fight.」

219:t_005:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Who would have thought that we'd pick up the $$ジェニオン$$'s distress signal, come to recover it, and end up in this.」

219:t_005:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So we have to fight something like that, this far from Earth...」

219:t_005:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Like I'd know! If they're picking a fight with us, we just fight back!」

219:t_005:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「To all units. We cannot afford to perish here.」

219:t_005:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We'll think about how to return to Earth later. First, concentrate on getting through the crisis in front of us.」

219:t_005:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「Once dead, you can do nothing. Think only about surviving for now.」

219:t_005:13.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$レド$$, $$チェインバー#pilot$$! Send the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ data to every unit!」

219:t_005:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. Transmitting tactical data.」

219:t_005:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$n, you link up with $$レド$$...!」

219:t_006:0.en:
$n
「$$レド$$! Sorry, but we're worn out from drifting. Today we'll play support!」

219:t_006:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Understood. I'm the one more used to dealing with them.」

219:t_006:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. Requesting tactical instructions.」

219:t_006:3.en:
$$レド$$
「Annihilation. When the enemy is the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, nothing else is possible.」

219:t_007:0.en:
$$レド$$
「We will annihilate the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$. There is no other option.」

219:t_007:2.en:
$n
「I've heard that for the $$人類銀河同盟$$ that $$レド$$ belonged to, fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ was everything...」

219:t_007:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Everyone born in the Alliance is raised as a soldier, and anyone who doesn't serve that purpose isn't allowed to live...」

219:t_007:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So for $$レド$$, fighting the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ is life itself...」

219:t_007:5.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's awful... Having your whole way of life decided by someone else...」
